_readme: EXPLICIT PATCH LIST, applied during derivation by scripts/derive-postcode-index.mjs.
WHY IT EXISTS: thailand_postcode_2026.json is newer than the thai-data package it
replaces (it carries the 2017 บางนา and 2021 บางบอน แขวง splits), but it drops five
real tambons that thai-data listed. Editing them back into the source file would
create a second hand-maintained copy of a file the user maintains upstream — the next
refresh would silently revert them. They live here instead, and the derivation applies
HOW AN ENTRY BECOMES LIVE: postcode, district and province must ALL be non-null.
An entry with any of them null is UNRESOLVED — the derivation skips it and prints it
as a warning. It is not an error and does not fail the build.
THE 'candidate' BLOCK IS DOCUMENTATION, NEVER APPLIED. It records what the OUTGOING
thai-data@3.0.2 said, so whoever resolves these has a starting point. It is not a
resolution: thai-data is the dataset being replaced precisely because it is wrong in
places — it files 10570 (อ.บางเสาธง) under 10540, and it disagrees with both the new
file and the public postcode sites about คลองหลา. A number from it is a lead to check,
not an answer to ship. Do not promote a candidate into `postcode` without confirming
